root_cause.text: The sca3000_probe function failed to free the IRQ allocated by request_threaded_irq when iio_device_register failed due to missing error handling logic that redirected execution to the cleanup handler.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the direct return of iio_device_register(indio_dev) to capture the return value and jump to the error_free_irq label upon failure, ensuring the IRQ cleanup path is executed.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement allocates an IRQ using request_threaded_irq() but lacks proper error handling for subsequent iio_device_register() failure. When iio_device_register() fails after this IRQ allocation, there is no cleanup path to free the IRQ via free_irq(), causing a resource leak. The fix requires adding error handling that redirects to a cleanup label calling free_irq() before returning.
